item.title: Version 2.1.6
item.description:
What's New in 2.1.6

A smoother, clearer first transcription — especially the very first time.

Transcribing just works

  • No more detour to Settings — if a speech model is needed, MindExtract now downloads it right where you are and starts transcribing automatically when it's ready.
  • Clear, one-time setup — before anything downloads, you see exactly what it is, how big it is, and that it runs fully offline and privately afterwards. Nothing happens out of the blue.
  • Plain-language engine choice — the Transcribe dialog now explains your options: Apple Speech is built into macOS (instant, nothing to download), and WhisperKit is an open-source alternative that works on any Mac.

Refinements

  • Fixed the progress bar overlapping the first line of text while transcribing.
